== Credits ==
[[File:GACredits.png|right]]
Credits are the standard currency in Global Assault. There are two ways to earn
credits in the game as well as two ways to spend credits.

Every player passively earns 20 credits per hour from their Generator. 
Generators have a maximum number of credits that they can store at one 
time and players must log on to collect credits from them. The second 
method to obtain credits is to win battles in the game. Other event 
based methods to obtain credits may appear.

Players may use credits to buy Supply Drops in the Store for 100 credits each or they may research/build in the Research Lab.
